QLoRA fine-tune of `Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct` for slot extraction (question -> strict JSON).

* Data: 2700 synthetic training questions and 120 held-out questions, generated by
  `finetune/make_parse_dataset.py` (labels known by construction; typos, lower case, Hinglish fillers,
  missing places and out-of-scope requests are over-sampled).
* LoRA r=16, alpha=32, dropout 0.05 on all attention and MLP projections; 4-bit NF4 base;
  1.0 epoch(s), learning rate 0.0002, effective batch 16, loss on the JSON answer only.
* Hardware: NVIDIA RTX 4500 Ada Generation; wall time 17 min.

| Metric | Base, synthetic held-out (120) | Fine-tuned, synthetic | Base, real questions (30) | Fine-tuned, real |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| exact | 65.0% | 94.2% | 73.3% | 83.3% |
| activity | 70.0% | 94.2% | 93.3% | 90.0% |
| location | 89.2% | 97.5% | 86.7% | 86.7% |
| profiles | 92.5% | 100.0% | 86.7% | 100.0% |
| valid json | 100.0% | 100.0% | 100.0% | 100.0% |

The synthetic held-out set comes from the same templates as the training data, so it is optimistic.
The real-question set (`finetune/real_eval.jsonl`) is hand-written and never used for training.

## On the production path (llama.cpp, Q4_K_M GGUF, JSON-schema-constrained decoding)

Measured with `SLM_GGUF_PATH` pointing at the converted model, same 30 hand-written questions:

| Metric | Base Qwen2.5-1.5B Q4_K_M | Fine-tuned Q4_K_M |
|---|---|---|
| exact | 76.7% | 93.3% |
| activity | 90.0% | 96.7% |
| location | 90.0% | 93.3% |
| profiles | 93.3% | 100.0% |
| answers written by the SLM and passing the grounding verifier (8 live questions) | 7/8 | 8/8 |

The fine-tune targets parsing only; answer writing did not degrade (8/8 verified).
